what_they_sell.claim: Postman provides an API discovery tool that lets users find and reuse APIs already in their organization.
what_they_sell.cited_excerpt: Find and reuse the APIs already in your org

what_they_sell.claim: Postman offers API testing capabilities that generate request collections and assertions to catch regressions.
what_they_sell.cited_excerpt: Generate request collections and assertions that catch regressions

what_they_sell.claim: Postman includes performance testing to simulate real-world load and surface bottlenecks.
what_they_sell.cited_excerpt: Simulate real-world load to surface bottlenecks

who_they_sell_to.claim: Postman targets developers and teams who need to browse, request, and manage access to approved APIs within an organization.
who_they_sell_to.cited_excerpt: Browse approved APIs, pick a duration, and request access. An admin approves the scope and can revoke it at any time.

who_they_sell_to.claim: Postman serves security and operations teams by providing a Secure Access Proxy that validates callers and swaps credentials inside the cloud.
who_they_sell_to.cited_excerpt: The proxy checks the caller and scope, then swaps the reference for the real secret inside your cloud.

outreach_hook.claim: Postman's Context Graph increased discovered services from 129 to 498 in a checkout scenario.
outreach_hook.cited_excerpt: An agent in one checkout finds 129 services. With the Context Graph, it finds 498.
